name: Bright Dolphin 91
author: Yaya12085
description: Gradient 3d pill white toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes perspective(100px) rotateX(5deg) rotateY(-5deg), transform becomes perspective(100px) rotateX(-5deg) rotateY(5deg). Clicking it toggles it: transform becomes perspective(100px) rotateX(-5deg) rotateY(5deg), left becomes 70px, background-color changes from #ffffff to #000000.
